rationale: Correcting the enumeration in the shutdown-completion record. That record said two request channels can hold an accepted request when the loop is not reading - the buffered apply channel and the verification channel. Re-reading the constructors and the enqueue paths shows a third: the leadership-transfer channel has capacity one, and its enqueue select succeeds from the buffer without the loop receiving, so a transfer future can be stuck there for the same reason; the configuration-channel buffer, by contrast, is only filled by a producer whose future arms the shutdown escape. Correction rather than a new fact, because the original statement's enumeration is what is inaccurate.

knowledge.statement: Requests that a client has successfully enqueued but that the main loop has not yet processed have no shutdown completion path. The main loop's shutdown case clears the known leader and returns; it does not drain or reject request channels. The leader's step-down cleanup responds to requests on its inflight list and to registered verification futures, which covers requests already dispatched or registered but not requests still sitting in a channel. The future type can return a shutdown error from its waiter only through a shutdown channel field, and the captured code sets that field only on the internal restore futures and on the configuration future the snapshot routine uses, never on the futures handed to callers by the apply, barrier, verify, snapshot, restore, bootstrap or transfer entry points. Three request channels can therefore hold an accepted request while the loop is not reading it: the apply channel when the configuration option that buffers it is enabled (capacity equal to the maximum append entries), the verification channel (capacity 64), and the leadership-transfer channel (capacity one, whose enqueue select succeeds from the buffer and reports an enqueue timeout only when the buffer is already full). The configuration-channel buffer is not such a case, because its only producer arms its future's shutdown escape. The unbuffered channels - configuration changes, user snapshot, user restore and bootstrap - cannot accept a request the loop has not received, so they are answered even during shutdown handling.
knowledge.conditions: Requires the instance to be shut down between a request being accepted into a buffered channel and the loop consuming it; the apply-channel case additionally requires the buffering option to be enabled, while the verification and leadership-transfer channels are buffered unconditionally.
knowledge.changed_premise: The original statement enumerated two buffered request channels (the buffered apply channel and the verification channel) and implied the remaining channels were unbuffered. That enumeration was incomplete: the leadership-transfer channel is buffered with capacity one and its enqueue path can succeed from the buffer, so a transfer future joins the class; and the configuration-change channel's buffer, while buffered, is filled only by a producer whose future carries the shutdown escape. The class of affected requests is therefore wider (transfers as well as applies and verifications) and the exclusion set is narrower (configuration requests are excluded for a different reason than the unbuffered ones). The mechanism, the harm (a caller waiting forever) and the ceiling are unchanged.

interpretations.rationale: The successor opinion corrects the enumeration of affected requests in the shutdown-completion record. The transfer channel is created with capacity one (api.go:570-574), and the enqueue helper selects between sending the future, the shutdown channel and a default that reports an enqueue timeout when the buffer is already occupied (raft.go:2198-2205); that means exactly one transfer future can be accepted from the buffer without the loop receiving it, and if the loop then returns on shutdown the future is never resolved - the same completion gap already recorded for queued applies (when the buffering option is on) and for verification requests. The correction also tightens the exclusion: the configuration-change channel's buffer is filled only by the snapshot routine's future, which arms the shutdown escape, so it is not an instance of the gap even though it is buffered. Nothing else changes: the mechanism is the missing drain plus unarmed escape fields, the harm remains a caller waiting forever, and the ceiling remains a client-side wait rather than loss or reordering of stored data. Recording this as a correction matters because the original enumeration would let a reader conclude that transfers are safe from the gap; they are not, and the transfer path is the one where a stuck future also means a caller cannot learn whether leadership changed.

knowledge.assertion: Corrected enumeration: apply (when buffered), verification and leadership-transfer channels can hold an accepted request at shutdown.

counterevidence: The leadership-transfer buffer holds at most one request, so the exposure is smaller than the verification channel's sixty-four and the buffered apply channel's capacity.
A caller can detect a saturated transfer buffer because the enqueue reports an enqueue timeout; what it cannot detect is the case where the send succeeded into the buffer and the loop then stopped.
The correction does not change the earlier counterevidence about shutdown being documented as not graceful, nor the mitigation of awaiting the shutdown future first.
No execution: the correction is a structural re-reading of the constructors and the enqueue helper.
limitations: Source-only; the same race was not observed for any of the three channels.
This is a correction of an enumeration, not a new mechanism; the earlier interpretation and counterevidence remain recorded alongside it.
Only the request channels were re-checked; other buffered channels in the instance were not re-examined.
interpretations.report_title: 修正枚举：领导权转移请求同样可能在关闭时无法完成
interpretations.report_answer: 本次修正上一轮“关闭时未完成请求”记录中的枚举（仅源码，未执行，实验额度已用尽）。原记录称有两个请求通道可能在主循环未读取时持有已接受的请求（开启缓冲选项的 apply 通道、以及 verify 通道），这并不完整：leadershipTransferCh 以容量 1 创建（api.go:570-574），其入队 select 在“发送 / shutdown / default 报入队超时”之间选择（raft.go:2198-2205），因此可以在主循环未接收的情况下由缓冲区接受一个转移请求；若此后循环因关闭而返回，该 future 同样永远不会被应答——与已记录的 apply（开启缓冲时）与 verify 相同。修正还收紧了排除项：配置变更通道虽为缓冲，但其唯一生产者（快照例程）为 future 绑定了 shutdown 逃生通道，故不属于该缺口。其余不变：机制是缺少排空且用户 future 未绑定逃生字段，危害仍是调用方永久等待，上限仍限于客户端等待而非数据丢失或乱序。之所以要修正，是因为按原枚举读者会以为转移路径不受影响；实际不然，而且转移路径上一个卡住的 future 还意味着调用方无法得知领导权是否已经改变。
